commands.name: get-devindiagnostics
commands.description:
Deep-dive companion to Check-DevinHealth.ps1. Gathers app version, WSL state,
    devin-server process and commit, server bundle integrity, superseded commit dirs,
    extension and log counts, host/guest memory, and scans the newest renderer log and
    the current server log for known error signatures (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, exthost
    crash loops, exited processes). Changes nothing: no files are written or deleted,
    no processes are started or stopped.

parameters.name: OutFile
parameters.description:
Optional path. When set, the report is also written to this file as JSON
    (in addition to the console output).

commands.name: repair-devin
commands.description:
Companion to Check-DevinHealth.ps1 (which detects problems and can repair a corrupt
    bundle). This script performs the individual repair actions with a dry-run default:
    with no switches it only prints what each repair WOULD do and changes nothing.

    Never touches: extensions/, data/, settings, the live commit dir, or .installation_lock.
    The rule from the field notes: check WSL health FIRST - stale .devin-server state is
    rarely the issue. The one exception is a corrupt bundle...

parameters.name: FixBundle
parameters.description:
Kill devin-server and delete the current commit's bundle dir so the next
    'Reload Window' in Devin re-downloads a fresh one (~700 MB). Only runs when the
    bundle actually fails the integrity test, unless -Commit names a specific commit
    or -Force is given.

parameters.name: Commit
parameters.description: 40-hex commit dir to target with -FixBundle instead of the auto-detected one.

parameters.name: CleanLeftovers
parameters.description:
Delete superseded commit dirs in ~/.devin-server/bin/ (everything except the live
    commit) plus their stale .log/.pid/.token sidecar files. Repairs leave the previous
    commit's dir behind; it is dead weight once the client has moved on.

parameters.name: PruneServerLogs
parameters.description:
Delete files in ~/.devin-server/data/logs/ older than -Days days (pre-repair
    session logs accumulate here).

parameters.name: Days
parameters.description: Age threshold in days for -PruneServerLogs. Default 14.

parameters.name: Confirm
parameters.description:
Accepted for explicitness; confirmation prompts appear by default before every
    destructive step.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description: Skip the confirmation prompts and (for -FixBundle) the intact-bundle refusal.

commands.name: config-loader
commands.description: Resolves the configuration file path relative to the script location.

parameters.name: ConfigPath
ConfigPath
parameters.description:
Path to the configuration file.

    .OUTPUTS
    PSCustomObject. The loaded configuration object.
    #>
    param(
        [string]$ConfigPath = "configs\system-config.json"
    )

    try {
        $fullPath = Get-ConfigPath -ConfigPath $ConfigPath

        if (-not (Test-Path $fullPath)) {
            Write-Warning "Configuration file not found: $fullPath"
            Write-Warning "Creating default configuration..."
            New-DefaultConfiguration -ConfigPath $ConfigPath
        }

        $jsonContent = Get-Content -Path $fullPath -Raw -Encoding UTF8
        $config = $jsonContent | ConvertFrom-Json

        # Validate configuration structure
        $isValid = Test-Configuration -Config $config
        if (-not $isValid) {
            Write-Warning "Configuration validation failed. Using default values."
            $config = Get-DefaultConfiguration
        }

        # Store in global variable
        $Global:DevOptimizerConfig = $config

        Write-Log "Configuration loaded successfully from: $fullPath" -Level "INFO" -Component "Config"
        return $config

    } catch {
        Write-Error "Failed to load configuration: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        Write-Log "Failed to load configuration: $($_.Exception.Message)" -Level "ERROR" -Component "Config"

        # Return default configuration as fallback
        $defaultConfig = Get-DefaultConfiguration
        $Global:DevOptimizerConfig = $defaultConfig
        return $defaultConfig
    }
}

function Get-Configuration {
    <#
    .SYNOPSIS
    Gets the current system configuration.

    .DESCRIPTION
    Returns the loaded configuration object. If not loaded, loads it first.

    .OUTPUTS
    PSCustomObject. The system configuration object.
    #>

    if ($Global:DevOptimizerConfig -eq $null) {
        Load-Configuration -ConfigPath "configs\system-config.json"
    }

    # Ensure we return a single object, not an array
    if ($Global:DevOptimizerConfig -is [array]) {
        Write-Log "Configuration loaded as array, taking first element" -Level "WARN" -Component "Config"
        return $Global:DevOptimizerConfig[0]
    }

    return $Global:DevOptimizerConfig
}
